ns2:course.label: Computational Statistics
ns2:course.description: Various topics, such as ridge regression; robust regression; jackknife, bootstrap, cross-validation and resampling plans; E-M algorithm; projection pursuit; all with a strong computational flavor. Same as CSE 525. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: STAT 425, STAT 426, and STAT 510 or 511; or consent of instructor.
